newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian lev rises to 1,575-1,580 to dlr at close.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian lev rises to 1,575-1,580 to dlr at close.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev rose to 1,575-1,580 per dollar at close from 1,590-1,595 at midday and the morning's 1,595-1,605 as foreign currency supply strongly topped demand, dealers said.
"The lev gained some 20 from the opening as dollar supply outweighed demand throughout the day, especially in the afternoon," one dealer said.
Dollar supply came mainly from final clients opting for lev-denominated investments amid the current lev stability.

"Lev instruments offer a much higher yield because the lev is stable. Despite the main rate cut the interest rate spread between dollar- and lev-denominated investments is still in favour of the lev,," another dealer said.
The Bulgarian National Bank on Thursday decided to cut its main interest rate to 17.14 percent monthly from 18 percent, in force from Monday.
The lev has traded stable between 1,560-1,620 in the past month. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
